framework.title: Towards a Periodic Table of Visualization Methods for Management
framework.method_inventory: 100 distinct method labels; legends excluded; spelling normalized
framework.artwork: Not copied; no redistribution permission established

evidence_kinds.observations: Records or measurements supplied by the provider
evidence_kinds.derived_summary: Reproducible calculation from cited source data
evidence_kinds.documented_structure: Relationships/definitions grounded in public source documentation
evidence_kinds.documented_workflow: Explicitly implemented data-processing workflow using real inputs
evidence_kinds.scenario: Teaching assumptions anchored to source evidence; no claim of measured outcomes

elements.question: How does PM2.5 vary along a concentration scale?
elements.proposed_output: A continuous scale with station positions, units, missingness, and a sorted dot-plot comparison.
elements.learner_activity: Change the time window and compare rankings with uncertainty.
elements.limitation: A color scale is not a measured risk threshold; use an explicit published threshold only when its source is given.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Where did the selected earthquakes occur in geographic and projected coordinates?
elements.proposed_output: Longitude-latitude scatter and a local projected distance plot with a coastline context.
elements.learner_activity: Compare angular and kilometer distances for two events.
elements.limitation: Degrees are not uniform distance; declare CRS, axis order, and projection distortion.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which counties have high estimated disease burden and uncertain socioeconomic estimates?
elements.proposed_output: A joined table with GEOIDs, units, source years, intervals, and accessible formatting.
elements.learner_activity: Audit an unmatched county and compare a sorted table with its chart.
elements.limitation: Keep ACS 90% margins distinct from PLACES 95% intervals; install/import jinja2 explicitly if using Styler.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What is the age composition of one county?
elements.proposed_output: A labeled age-share pie beside a 100% stacked bar using mutually exclusive age bins.
elements.learner_activity: Change the county and explain which representation makes small differences clearer.
elements.limitation: Use a common denominator and exhaustive bins; do not mix overlapping categories.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do the CO2 trend and seasonal cycle differ?
elements.proposed_output: Monthly series with flagged gaps, trend, and a separate detrended panel.
elements.learner_activity: Compare endpoint changes over two complete windows.
elements.limitation: Connect only valid consecutive observations; changing the window changes the apparent trend.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do facility counts and sites per population differ across counties?
elements.proposed_output: Sorted counts and per-100,000 rates with labeled denominators and data dates.
elements.learner_activity: Find a county whose ranking reverses after normalization.
elements.limitation: Sites are not capacity; misaligned dates and small denominators affect rates.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What does the regional earthquake depth distribution look like?
elements.proposed_output: Count histogram, ECDF, and alternative depth bins.
elements.learner_activity: Change bin width and compare shallow/deep proportions.
elements.limitation: Catalog selection, magnitude threshold, and depth uncertainty affect the distribution.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How does the distribution of recorded AQI days change across years?
elements.proposed_output: Stacked annual day counts and a separate share view with missing days explicit.
elements.learner_activity: Compare one complete year with an incomplete year and defend the denominator.
elements.limitation: AQI categories apply to recorded days; do not turn unobserved days into good-air days.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How are county poverty estimates associated with modeled diabetes prevalence?
elements.proposed_output: Labeled scatter, uncertainty annotations, and sensitivity to population weighting.
elements.learner_activity: Compare crude and age-adjusted measures and discuss the changed pattern.
elements.limitation: Ecological association is not individual risk or causation; align geography and years.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do daily temperature distributions vary by season and station?
elements.proposed_output: Seasonal Tukey boxes with sample counts, points, and missingness panel.
elements.learner_activity: Inspect a flagged extreme before deciding whether to exclude it.
elements.limitation: Whiskers are not confidence intervals; spell out the outlier convention and units.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How persistent is the annual cycle in monthly CO2 observations?
elements.proposed_output: Detrended series, windowed spectrogram with periods in months, and a seasonal comparison.
elements.learner_activity: Change the analysis window and explain the resolution tradeoff.
elements.limitation: Monthly sampling limits frequencies; handle gaps and trend leakage without inventing observations.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do selected counties compare across several health and social indicators?
elements.proposed_output: Normalized radar profiles beside a dot-plot panel with raw units and denominators.
elements.learner_activity: Reverse an axis order and test whether the visual conclusion survives.
elements.limitation: Area depends on axis order and normalization; no unsupported composite health score.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which county profiles combine chronic disease, poverty, and air-quality differences?
elements.proposed_output: Brushed parallel coordinates with explicit scaling, missing-value handling, and selected county table.
elements.learner_activity: Compare robust scaling with min-max scaling and inspect a selected profile.
elements.limitation: Mixed units and missing monitors can dominate patterns; profiles are not individual records.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can users explore a large state-county-facility hierarchy?
elements.proposed_output: A real hyperbolic focus/context tree of public facility records and an accessible expandable tree.
elements.learner_activity: Follow a selected site through both views and record which context is preserved.
elements.limitation: Implement hyperbolic layout explicitly; an ordinary radial tree must not be called hyperbolic.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How does the annual CO2 seasonal cycle repeat?
elements.proposed_output: Month-of-year cycle with multi-year spread and an adjacent chronological plot.
elements.learner_activity: Compare two periods and identify which feature a cycle hides.
elements.limitation: Wrapping months suppresses long-term change; retain dates and sample counts.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: When did earthquakes occur within a fixed regional sequence?
elements.proposed_output: Event timeline with magnitude symbols, selected-event details, and daily counts.
elements.learner_activity: Change the magnitude cutoff and explain changes in apparent clustering.
elements.limitation: Catalog thresholds affect apparent activity; occurrence patterns do not forecast the next event.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which counties meet three explicitly defined screening criteria?
elements.proposed_output: Exact set-intersection table, Euler/Venn view, and an UpSet-style comparison.
elements.learner_activity: Vary a cutoff and identify counties that change membership.
elements.limitation: Cutoffs are teaching assumptions, missing values are separate, and areas must not imply inaccurate counts.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How are people distributed across age and poverty-status categories?
elements.proposed_output: A Sankey built from a published cross-tabulation plus its source table and balance checks.
elements.learner_activity: Verify every incoming and outgoing total and compare a stacked bar.
elements.limitation: Never fabricate joint distributions from unrelated marginal totals; this is composition, not individual movement.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a reader magnify uncertain county estimates without losing national context?
elements.proposed_output: Focus-and-context table lens with highlighted estimate/interval columns and a full table alternative.
elements.learner_activity: Change the focus county and trace a value through both representations.
elements.limitation: A lens changes display scale, not the underlying value; preserve consistent labels and accessible navigation.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How should county, release, indicator, and facility tables join?
elements.proposed_output: An ER diagram with keys, cardinalities, vintage fields, and tested example joins.
elements.learner_activity: Introduce a duplicate GEOID-release pair and show the failed validation.
elements.limitation: A many-to-many join can multiply counts; identifiers and geography vintages require explicit constraints.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do imagery download, quality checks, and approvals synchronize?
elements.proposed_output: A token-based Petri net for the documented imagery workflow with transitions and simulated execution log.
elements.learner_activity: Block a cloud-quality gate and find the unreachable publication state.
elements.limitation: Tokens and durations are a teaching model, not observed agency operations; demonstrate actual firing semantics.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How should a daily air-quality record pass validation?
elements.proposed_output: Executable quality-control branches paired with the EPA field definitions and a record audit table.
elements.learner_activity: Trace a missing, flagged, and valid observation through the decisions.
elements.limitation: A quality flag is not permission to discard data silently; preserve reasons and source records.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which counties have similar measured indicator profiles?
elements.proposed_output: Scaled clustering with cluster profiles, distances, and a linked map.
elements.learner_activity: Change feature scaling or cluster count and compare stability.
elements.limitation: Clusters are analyst choices; avoid stigmatizing labels and causal interpretations.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do county disease estimates vary when boundaries and denominators are respected?
elements.proposed_output: County choropleth, proportional-symbol comparison, legend, intervals, and unmatched-geography table.
elements.learner_activity: Compare equal-interval and quantile classes and document changed impressions.
elements.limitation: Use a licensed Census county geometry source; area is not population and absent values are not zero.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How are public health-center sites distributed through state and county hierarchies?
elements.proposed_output: Nested area-proportional treemap with count labels and a ranked table.
elements.learner_activity: Check area proportionality and compare a small county with the table.
elements.limitation: Declare the grouping and count unit; site counts do not measure service capacity.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Does a 3D hierarchy help explore state-county-site organization?
elements.proposed_output: A rotatable cone-tree scene with depth legend and a 2D expandable-tree fallback.
elements.learner_activity: Locate a site and compare occlusion and navigation effort in both views.
elements.limitation: A cone tree requires its actual 3D hierarchical layout; display depth is not geographic elevation.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How might population, service capacity, and queues interact over time?
elements.proposed_output: Stock-flow equations, time-series simulation, and sensitivity plots using real population/site context.
elements.learner_activity: Change capacity and delay assumptions and compare trajectories.
elements.limitation: Rates, capacity, queues, and causal links are explicit assumptions; results are not calibrated forecasts.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Where do data change as county indicators become a dashboard?
elements.proposed_output: A process/store/external-entity DFD linked to input hashes, joins, and output summaries.
elements.learner_activity: Trace one plotted value back through its transformations.
elements.limitation: Use DFD semantics rather than a generic flow chart; data lineage does not establish analytical validity.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How are indicator concepts, geography, and services related in public metadata?
elements.proposed_output: A typed graph of definitions and source-backed relationships with a searchable edge table.
elements.learner_activity: Challenge an edge and locate the exact supporting definition.
elements.limitation: Distinguish semantic, statistical, and causal relations; graph proximity is not scientific evidence.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a team retain evidence and unresolved decisions during a facility-access discussion?
elements.proposed_output: A timestamped simulated meeting trace linking each claim to an evidence card and decision log.
elements.learner_activity: Reconstruct which assumption changed a proposed priority.
elements.limitation: The meeting is authored teaching material; do not imply real participants made these statements.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Who exchanges what information during a public-data refresh?
elements.proposed_output: Actors, numbered messages, data contracts, and a trace for one downloaded file.
elements.learner_activity: Add a failed-source response and trace its notification path.
elements.limitation: Model information exchange, not surveillance or undocumented agency reporting relationships.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What is a defensible route from earthquake data to an explanatory story?
elements.proposed_output: A mission-style plan with checkpoints, evidence gates, outputs, and a small observed event summary.
elements.learner_activity: Change the target audience and revise the checkpoints.
elements.limitation: Dates and effort are planning assumptions, not actual response operations.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which core ideas are required to interpret a population-access map?
elements.proposed_output: A sparse prerequisite skeleton expanded into definitions and examples from the data dictionary.
elements.learner_activity: Identify a missing prerequisite and show the misunderstanding it prevents.
elements.limitation: Do not turn a metaphor into an anatomical or causal claim; label the abstraction.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What questions connect climate conditions and health indicators?
elements.proposed_output: An expandable mind map with source-linked branches and a comparison to a concept map.
elements.learner_activity: Add a question that would require data the course does not contain.
elements.limitation: Free association is not a demonstrated relationship; distinguish hypotheses from measured variables.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do universal and particular claims differ when facility metadata are incomplete?
elements.proposed_output: A logical square using carefully defined predicates and a supporting missingness table.
elements.learner_activity: Test the claims on an empty subset and explain existential assumptions.
elements.limitation: Modern logic does not support all traditional square relations without existential import; unknown is not false.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How does estimated population vary in distance bands around a facility?
elements.proposed_output: True spatial rings with population summaries and a non-map band chart.
elements.learner_activity: Change radius and compare overlap-aware totals.
elements.limitation: Use a suitable projected CRS and avoid double counting overlaps; rings do not model roads or travel time.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What evidence supports a cautious statement about unequal chronic-disease burden?
elements.proposed_output: One evidence-led slide with headline, chart, source, counterpoint, and uncertainty statement.
elements.learner_activity: Rewrite an overclaimed headline to match the data.
elements.limitation: County estimates support descriptive comparison, not a claim about causes or individual patients.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which roles own imagery selection, processing, validation, and publication?
elements.proposed_output: Role-based lanes with artifacts, quality gates, and a worked data-item example.
elements.learner_activity: Move a failed cloud-mask result through the correct return path.
elements.limitation: Roles are an illustrative course workflow, not a representation of an actual agency's organization.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How would a small team schedule a reproducible county-health analysis?
elements.proposed_output: Tasks linked to real source requirements, dependencies, scenario durations, and milestones.
elements.learner_activity: Delay a data-quality task and update the completion date.
elements.limitation: Durations are assumed; a visually overlapping bar does not establish a dependency.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How might residents, analysts, and service planners read the same access evidence differently?
elements.proposed_output: A source-annotated perspective matrix with common facts and distinct hypothetical concerns.
elements.learner_activity: Identify a perspective missing from the initial design.
elements.limitation: Do not assign real communities unelicited beliefs; prompts are provisional and invite local input.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How should a public map balance detail with the risk of misinterpretation?
elements.proposed_output: Competing options, benefits, harms, evidence gaps, and an aggregation demonstration.
elements.learner_activity: Compare two publication scales and justify a revision.
elements.limitation: Public facility points and sensitive patient locations are different data classes; no patient mapping is required.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What belongs in the data, analysis, and communication layers of an access story?
elements.proposed_output: An annotated layer stack with real sample outputs and lineage between layers.
elements.learner_activity: Remove one layer and identify which claim becomes unsupported.
elements.limitation: A display layer is not an independent line of evidence; clarify CRS and resolution at each stage.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a reader move from an air-quality conclusion to supporting evidence?
elements.proposed_output: A conclusion-evidence pyramid with labeled annual/day-level summaries and a counterexample.
elements.learner_activity: Rebuild the pyramid after finding incomplete monitoring coverage.
elements.limitation: The hierarchy organizes an argument; it does not replace uncertainty or prove causality.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which proposed links between heat and health are measured, assumed, or absent?
elements.proposed_output: A typed causal-hypothesis chain beside observed climate summaries and an evidence-gap table.
elements.learner_activity: Identify a confounder and show why the available data cannot estimate the effect.
elements.limitation: Association and mechanisms need different evidence; do not infer causal effects from unmatched datasets.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What warrants and qualifications connect an air-quality chart to a public claim?
elements.proposed_output: A claim-data-warrant-backing-rebuttal map with explicit source references.
elements.learner_activity: Construct a rebuttal based on monitor coverage or population denominators.
elements.limitation: A plausible warrant is not measured evidence; retain qualifiers and alternative explanations.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How might transparent rules flag counties for further review?
elements.proposed_output: An interpretable screening-rule tree, example paths, and a threshold sensitivity table.
elements.learner_activity: Change one threshold and audit which counties change status.
elements.limitation: Analyst thresholds are not medical triage rules or validated eligibility criteria.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which preparation tasks control delivery of a small imagery lesson?
elements.proposed_output: A dependency DAG, forward/backward pass, slack table, and highlighted critical path.
elements.learner_activity: Change a noncritical duration until it changes the critical path.
elements.limitation: Task durations are assumptions; the method requires actual dependency calculations, not highlighted arrows alone.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What alternative approaches could improve a facility-access assessment?
elements.proposed_output: A concept fan from purpose through approaches to feasible analyses, each tied to available evidence.
elements.learner_activity: Compare distance, capacity, and travel-time approaches and mark unavailable inputs.
elements.limitation: An attractive branch is a research option, not an established intervention benefit.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do geography, denominators, estimates, and uncertainty connect?
elements.proposed_output: A labeled proposition map with cross-links and worked examples from two releases.
elements.learner_activity: Read every edge as a sentence and correct an unsupported proposition.
elements.limitation: Use explicit linking phrases; proximity and arrows without semantics are insufficient.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can an access project expose conflicting purposes before choosing metrics?
elements.proposed_output: A rich situation summary, CATWOE/root definitions, conceptual activity model, and comparison with public data.
elements.learner_activity: Compare two stakeholder worldviews and identify a feasible improvement question.
elements.limitation: This is a structured inquiry, not a calibrated simulation or a claim of stakeholder consensus.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which proposed data-quality and outreach activities might reinforce one another?
elements.proposed_output: A time-oriented relationship map with complementary/conflicting activities and an evidence ledger.
elements.learner_activity: Remove one assumed relationship and reassess the plan.
elements.limitation: Synergy strengths are hypothetical until evaluated; avoid presenting made-up benefits as outcomes.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What helps or hinders an equitable browser-based mapping workshop?
elements.proposed_output: Driving/restraining forces supported by measured file sizes and documented device/network constraints.
elements.learner_activity: Change an assumed weight and test whether the recommendation changes.
elements.limitation: Separate actual runtime measurements from unelicited judgments about a community.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a team retain issues, positions, and arguments about county prioritization?
elements.proposed_output: An IBIS graph with typed nodes, source-linked arguments, and unresolved issues.
elements.learner_activity: Add a counter-position and trace which evidence it challenges.
elements.limitation: Argument counts are not votes, truth probabilities, or stakeholder agreement.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which events trigger each stage of a reproducible imagery refresh?
elements.proposed_output: An event-driven process chain with alternating events/functions and explicit AND/XOR connectors.
elements.learner_activity: Trace an invalid asset through the failure branch.
elements.limitation: Use event/function semantics; downloaded metadata alone does not mean pixels passed validation.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How does uncertain preparation effort affect the lesson delivery plan?
elements.proposed_output: A dependency network with optimistic/likely/pessimistic durations and calculated expected times.
elements.learner_activity: Compare PERT estimates with a small Monte Carlo duration experiment.
elements.limitation: Assumptions about duration distributions and dependence limit any completion probability.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which visual anchors help learners recall units, scales, and climate-data limitations?
elements.proposed_output: An original illustrated map of concepts with source-linked mini-charts and retrieval prompts.
elements.learner_activity: Recall three distinctions before reopening the source cards.
elements.limitation: Memory cues are authored illustrations, not additional data or claims that learning improved without evaluation.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do an earthquake question, conceptual model, observations, and conclusions connect?
elements.proposed_output: A Vee linking the focus question, catalog concepts, record selection, transforms, and justified claims.
elements.learner_activity: Trace one conclusion down to an event record and back to its assumptions.
elements.limitation: A diagram of inquiry cannot remove selection bias or depth uncertainty.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can learners navigate alternative routes through a county-health investigation?
elements.proposed_output: An original schematic route map with analysis stops, transfers, prerequisites, and links to evidence.
elements.learner_activity: Take a different route and identify the shared validation stop.
elements.limitation: The metro geometry encodes learning order, not actual transport, distance, or service access.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What evidence pillars support a defensible county air-quality comparison?
elements.proposed_output: A temple metaphor with foundation definitions, separate evidence pillars, and a qualified conclusion.
elements.learner_activity: Remove a denominator or quality-control pillar and revise the claim.
elements.limitation: Architectural symmetry must not imply equal evidential strength or independent data sources.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a fixed earthquake sequence become an explanatory geographic story?
elements.proposed_output: A setting-question-evidence-limits-reflection template with timeline, map, 3D depth scene, and table.
elements.learner_activity: Reorder the evidence and explain how the narrative emphasis changes.
elements.limitation: Avoid disaster sensationalism and prediction claims; event depth is not surface elevation.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a branching metaphor organize public facility categories?
elements.proposed_output: A category tree populated from site metadata with leaf counts and a tabular taxonomy.
elements.learner_activity: Reclassify an ambiguous site and document the consequence.
elements.limitation: Administrative categories are not evolutionary relationships or measures of service quality.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What joins and assumptions bridge a demographic question to a health comparison?
elements.proposed_output: A bridge metaphor whose supports are source checks, GEOIDs, definitions, and period alignment.
elements.learner_activity: Break one support using a mismatched geography vintage and diagnose the join.
elements.limitation: The metaphor must expose validation requirements rather than imply the datasets are automatically compatible.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How many imagery candidates remain after reproducible selection and quality filters?
elements.proposed_output: A stage-count funnel with the exact STAC query, filters, item IDs, and rejected-item reasons.
elements.learner_activity: Reorder two filters and inspect the retained candidate set.
elements.limitation: Stage counts are selection counts, not measured health outcomes; use actual metadata and pixel checks where required.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How do magnitude and depth occupy different measurement scales?
elements.proposed_output: Independent rulers with observed event markers, units, limits, and a log-energy explanation.
elements.learner_activity: Compare a magnitude difference with a depth difference without merging their units.
elements.limitation: Magnitude is logarithmic and magnitude types differ; ruler length must not imply linear energy.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Which assumptions lie beneath a simple facility-access map?
elements.proposed_output: An iceberg with visible outputs and submerged coverage, population-model, projection, and capacity caveats.
elements.learner_activity: Inspect one visible pattern and list the hidden inputs it depends on.
elements.limitation: The drawing does not quantify the share of known versus unknown information.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What are the best- and worst-case consequences of a proposed access dashboard?
elements.proposed_output: Paired opportunity/risk scenarios, real source constraints, and mitigation questions.
elements.learner_activity: Revise both scenarios after observing missing facility attributes.
elements.limitation: Extremes are discussion scenarios, not forecasts or measured stakeholder preferences.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can a workshop capture an evidence-aware discussion of access to services?
elements.proposed_output: An original visual record mixing a real county summary, icons, hypotheses, decisions, and open questions.
elements.learner_activity: Tag every mark as evidence, assumption, question, or decision.
elements.limitation: The facilitated session is illustrative; icons and dialogue must be original and clearly attributed where reused.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Why can a plausible county-health chart still mislead?
elements.proposed_output: An original short illustrated sequence about denominators, accompanied by real counts and rate comparisons.
elements.learner_activity: Rewrite the final panel to acknowledge uncertainty.
elements.limitation: Characters are fictional; humor must not stereotype patients or communities and is not substitute evidence.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: What social, technical, and evidence issues surround a population-access map?
elements.proposed_output: An original rich picture with public data anchors, hypothetical actors, tensions, and an explanatory legend.
elements.learner_activity: Add a missing concern and distinguish its evidence status.
elements.limitation: Do not portray imagined community preferences as field research or imply that facility points measure care quality.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: Where are the course's evidence, definitions, expertise, and gaps located?
elements.proposed_output: An interactive knowledge map linking datasets, methods, caveats, and source cards with a list alternative.
elements.learner_activity: Follow a claim to its data and identify an unresolved evidence gap.
elements.limitation: A resource relationship is not a causal relationship; preserve accessible navigation and stable links.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can learners plan a route from basic charts to a responsible 3D story?
elements.proposed_output: An original learning landscape with objectives, prerequisites, worked examples, reflection stops, and progress export.
elements.learner_activity: Choose a beginner and an advanced route and explain prerequisite choices.
elements.limitation: Do not imitate the publisher's poster or claim that a progress check proves mastery.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How can multiple county-health views form one coherent evidence story?
elements.proposed_output: A coordinated large-format dashboard of maps, distributions, uncertainty, narrative, and data tables.
elements.learner_activity: Trace a highlighted county across every panel and test a competing interpretation.
elements.limitation: All panels must share explicit selection state and source years; visual coherence does not imply causal coherence.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How might assumed service supply and demand respond to a capacity decision?
elements.proposed_output: Explicit hypothetical curves anchored to observed population/site context plus sensitivity plots.
elements.learner_activity: Change elasticities and compare the assumed intersection.
elements.limitation: Sites and population do not identify economic supply/demand curves; distinguish this from the legacy supply-chain sketch.
elements.runtime: JupyterLite Python; exported browser scene where specified

elements.question: How does monitored air quality compare with an explicit historical baseline?
elements.proposed_output: Actual AQI time series, baseline bands, completeness, and a table of deviations.
elements.learner_activity: Compare a rolling baseline with a fixed historical baseline.
